{"notes": "VISIT 1 (left at 1:45). Fish design, both lines connected to start. Top line is now complete out to the tail tip (~27,14.5). Bottom line is connected but ends around (20.8,12), short of the tail crossing. No fallen or disconnected dominoes visible. I don't know who placed which domino, so I'm rating only on what I saw and heard.

SOFIA: Jack credited her with the fish sketch, so she seems to have set the concept and the team's direction. I saw and heard nothing else from her this visit. I don't know whether she's building, and Jack's 'Sofia, shout if you're already on it' got no reply that I heard. Evidence is thin. Ask her next visit what she's working on and whether she's been heard.

OMAR: At 1:15 he reported finishing his line at the belly low point and gave Hana a clear, specific handoff ('join on from my last domino'). Good collaboration and communication. The belly line is smooth and connected. Execution looks solid.

HANA: Took the handoff and the bottom line has continued past the belly up to ~(20.8,12). It is connected and smoothly curved, which looks good. I didn't see her place dominoes, and she hasn't spoken while I was there. She was given the bottom tail at 1:30, and it's still unfinished. Check next visit that she's finishing it and not blocked.

JACK: Offered support without crowding (1:15), then at 1:30 spotted the top line stopped short with nobody on it and said he'd extend it, asking Sofia to shout if she was already on it. That shows initiative, clear communication and good coordination, and the top line now reaches the tail tip. He also assigned Hana the bottom tail, which is light-touch leadership. I didn't see him place dominoes. Watch the tail crossing."}
